description: Search the New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services' free public Business Name Search (njportal.com/DOR/BusinessNameSearch). No login required.

businessName.description: For mode=byName: name or partial name to search for, e.g. `Amazon` (contains match). For mode=availability: a candidate name WITHOUT a business designator (no `LLC`, `Inc`, `Corp`, etc. -- the source rejects those) to check whether it conflicts with an already-registered name.
businessName.title: Business name (mode=byName, availability)

cityFilter.description: Exact (case-insensitive) match against the registered business's on-file city. Leave blank for no filter.
cityFilter.title: City filter (mode=byName, byKeyword)

entityIds.description: Exact 10-digit New Jersey entity ID(s) to look up, e.g. `0450567823`.
entityIds.title: Entity IDs (mode=byEntityId)

entityTypeContains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter against the full entity type description, e.g. `Limited Liability` or `Corporation`. Leave blank for no filter.
entityTypeContains.title: Entity type contains (mode=byName, byKeyword)

keywords.description: 1-5 keywords; results contain ALL of them (in any order) somewhere in the registered business name, e.g. `["Amazon", "LLC"]`.
keywords.title: Keywords (mode=byKeyword)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. The source's registered-business searches return all matches in a single response (no server pagination); this cap is applied client-side.
maxItems.title: Max items

enumTitles: Search registered businesses by up to 5 keywords
Lookup registered business by exact 10-digit entity ID
Check if a business name is available for a new filing
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Uses Apify's free datacenter (AUTO) proxy group to get a fresh IP if a request is rate-limited by the source. Residential proxy is never used by this actor.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: New Jersey DOR Business Name Search Scraper Input
